item.title: Middleport man charged after $5,000 in tools reported stolen in Hartford
item.description: HARTFORD, W.Va. — Authorities are investigating the theft of approximately $5,000 worth of tools from a utility trailer on High Street in Hartford.

item.title: Mason County Board of Education honors Social Studies Fair winners, extends superintendent’s contract
item.description: POINT PLEASANT, W.Va. — The Mason County Board of Education held its regular meeting Tuesday evening, honoring student achievement and taking action on key personnel matters.

item.title: Marshall Health Network announces March screenings and community events
item.description: HUNTINGTON, W.Va. — In recognition of Colorectal Cancer Awareness Month, Marshall Health Network has announced a series of community events, health screenings and support programs scheduled throughout March 2026 to connect residents with preventive care and health resources.

item.title: Gallia County Local School Board approves forecast update, policy adoptions and personnel appointments
item.description: GALLIPOLIS, Ohio — The Gallia County Local Board of Education met Feb. 23 for its regular session, approving updates to district policies, financial measures and several personnel appointments.

item.title: Rutland Halloween Spooktacular named Best of River Cities Annual Festival
item.description: RUTLAND — The Rutland Halloween Spooktacular was recently voted “The Best of River Cities Annual Festival” in the 2026 Best of River Cities Contest. Rutland Mayor Tyler M. Eblin and Councilor Madalyn Wood are giving thanks for the recognition.

item.title: 77,159 concealed handgun permits issued in Ohio in 2025
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio — Ohio Attorney General Dave Yost on Friday issued the state’s annual report on concealed handgun licensing, showing that 77,159 permits were issued across the state in 2025.
